subject: Request: Submit information and links to your favorite public data set

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Request: Submit information and links to your favorite public data set
parts:
Hi,

I've created an aroma.affymetrix page called 'Data Sets', which lists
public data sets based on the Affymetrix platform:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/data-sets

If you know of any public data sets that are useful for testing or
with interesting experimental setup, please consider sending
information on them to this thread in a format like:

Affymetrix: 14 Human Mitochondrial Resequencing samples
URL: http://www.affymetrix.com/support/datasets.affx
Description: This dataset contains 14 Mitov2 array CEL files. The
probe array files represent 3 sets of CEPH trios including 2 sets of
technical replicates and 2 human mito standard samples.

Thanks

Henrik
